description: This file defines a custom exception class 'AttendanceServiceException' used within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It provides static methods for generating specific exception instances related to attendance punch-in/out operations, time validation, and record management.

classes.name: AttendanceServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling errors related to attendance services in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: punchOutAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the punch-out action cannot proceed because the employee has already punched out.

methods.name: punchInAlreadyExist
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the punch-in action cannot proceed because the employee has already punched in.

methods.name: punchOutTimeBehindThanPunchInTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the punch-out time is earlier than the punch-in time.

methods.name: punchInOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that an overlap was detected during punch-in.

methods.name: punchOutOverlapFound
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that an overlap was detected during punch-out.

methods.name: invalidDateTime
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the provided date and time are invalid.

methods.name: punchOutDateTimeNull
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that the punch-out date and time should not be null.

methods.name: deletableAttendanceRecordIdsEmpty
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that no IDs were found for deletion.

methods.name: invalidTimezoneDetails
methods.description: Returns an exception indicating that valid timezone offset and name must be provided.
